nodes.name: appsettings.json
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration for the MCP server host, specifying logging levels and the PostgreSQL connection string used by the MCP server's EF Core DbContext.

nodes.name: ApiWebApplicationFactory.cs
nodes.summary: xUnit WebApplicationFactory that opens a fresh in-memory SQLite database per test class and swaps it into the API's DI container, providing the shared test host used by all integration tests.

nodes.name: ApiWebApplicationFactory
nodes.summary: Custom WebApplicationFactory that opens an in-memory SQLite connection, replaces the app's AppDbContext registration with it, and disposes the connection after tests complete.

nodes.name: AuditLogTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests verifying that create/update/delete operations on employees and departments produce correct audit log entries, and that the audit log query endpoint enforces date-range filtering and admin-only authorization.

nodes.name: AuditLogTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering audit trail creation for employee/department mutations and access control on the audit log query endpoint.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_WritesOneCreatedAuditEntry
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating an employee produces exactly one "Created" audit log entry containing the employee's name.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_WritesOneUpdatedAuditEntryWithDiff
nodes.summary: Verifies that updating an employee's salary produces one "Updated" audit entry whose diff contains both the old and new salary values.

nodes.name: DeleteEmployee_WritesOneDeletedAuditEntry
nodes.summary: Verifies that deleting an employee produces exactly one "Deleted" audit log entry.

nodes.name: CreateAndUpdateDepartment_WritesAuditEntries
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating and then updating a department both produce audit log entries reflecting the change.

nodes.name: GetAuditLogs_FiltersByEntityNameAndDateRange
nodes.summary: Verifies the audit log query endpoint filters results by entity name and excludes entries outside a given date range.

nodes.name: GetAuditLogs_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from querying the audit log endpoint.

nodes.name: AuthTestHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Shared test helper that logs a test HttpClient in as the seeded admin or viewer account, used across most integration test classes.

nodes.name: AuthTestHelper
nodes.summary: Static helper providing LoginAsAdminAsync/LoginAsViewerAsync methods that authenticate a test HttpClient against the seeded accounts.

nodes.name: AuthTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering login, refresh-token rotation and reuse detection, logout, and role-based authorization (admin vs viewer) across the employee and department endpoints.

nodes.name: AuthTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering the login/refresh/logout flow and role-based access control (admin vs viewer) on employee and department endpoints.

nodes.name: Login_ValidAdminCredentials_ReturnsOkWithUserInfo
nodes.summary: Verifies that logging in with valid admin credentials returns 200 OK with the admin's user info.

nodes.name: Refresh_WithValidRefreshCookie_RotatesAccessToken
nodes.summary: Verifies that calling refresh with a valid refresh-token cookie issues a new access token.

nodes.name: Refresh_ReusingRotatedAwayRefreshToken_ReturnsUnauthorized
nodes.summary: Verifies that reusing a refresh token which has already been rotated away is rejected with 401 Unauthorized, guarding against refresh-token replay.

nodes.name: Logout_ThenReusingRefreshToken_ReturnsUnauthorized
nodes.summary: Verifies that after logout, the previously issued refresh token can no longer be used to obtain a new access token.

nodes.name: GetEmployees_AsViewer_Succeeds
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user can successfully list employees.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from creating an employee.

nodes.name: CreateDepartment_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from creating a department.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_AsAdmin_Succeeds
nodes.summary: Verifies that an admin-role user can successfully create an employee.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from updating an employee created by an admin.

nodes.name: DeleteEmployee_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from deleting an employee created by an admin.

nodes.name: UpdateDepartment_AsViewer_ReturnsForbidden
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user is forbidden from updating a department created by an admin.

nodes.name: GetEmployees_WithMalformedToken_ReturnsUnauthorized
nodes.summary: Verifies that supplying a malformed bearer token to the employees endpoint returns 401 Unauthorized.

nodes.name: DepartmentCrudTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering department creation, duplicate-name and unique-constraint validation, updates including active-toggle, and default filtering of disabled departments.

nodes.name: DepartmentCrudTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering CRUD behavior and validation rules for the department endpoint, including disabled-department edge cases.

nodes.name: CreateDepartment_PersistsAsActiveByDefault
nodes.summary: Verifies that a newly created department defaults to active status.

nodes.name: CreateDepartment_DuplicateName_ReturnsValidationProblem
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating a department with a name that already exists returns a validation problem.

nodes.name: CreateDepartment_UniqueConstraintViolationAtSaveTime_ReturnsValidationProblemNot500
nodes.summary: Verifies that a race-condition unique-constraint violation at save time (simulated via a rebuilt web host) is translated into a 400 validation problem rather than surfacing as a 500 error.

nodes.name: UpdateDepartment_RenamesAndTogglesActive
nodes.summary: Verifies that updating a department can rename it and toggle its active flag in one request.

nodes.name: GetDepartments_ExcludesDisabledByDefault_ButIncludesWhenRequested
nodes.summary: Verifies that listing departments excludes disabled ones by default but includes them when explicitly requested.

nodes.name: ExistingEmployee_ReferencingDisabledDepartment_StillRendersAndSaves
nodes.summary: Verifies that an employee referencing a since-disabled department still renders correctly and can still be saved/updated.

nodes.name: EmployeeCrudTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering employee creation, field validation (name, department, salary, join date), updates, and deletion.

nodes.name: EmployeeCrudTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering CRUD behavior and field-level validation for the employee endpoint.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_PersistsAndReturnsCreated
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating a valid employee persists the record and returns a 201 Created response with the employee's data.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_MissingName_ReturnsValidationProblem
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating an employee without a name returns a validation problem.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_UnknownDepartment_ReturnsValidationProblem
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating an employee with a department id that does not exist returns a validation problem.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_NegativeSalary_ReturnsValidationProblem
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating an employee with a negative salary returns a validation problem.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_InvalidJoinDate_ReturnsValidationProblem
nodes.summary: Verifies that creating an employee with an invalid join date returns a validation problem.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_ChangesFieldsAndPersists
nodes.summary: Verifies that updating an employee's fields persists the new values.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_NotFound_Returns404
nodes.summary: Verifies that updating a non-existent employee id returns 404 Not Found.

nodes.name: DeleteEmployee_RemovesRecord
nodes.summary: Verifies that deleting an employee removes the record so subsequent lookups fail.

nodes.name: EmployeeImportExportTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering Excel-based employee import (valid rows, native Excel date cells, mixed valid/invalid rows) and Excel/CSV export, including a round-trip export-then-reimport check and viewer-role authorization.

nodes.name: EmployeeImportExportTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering the Excel import/export endpoints, including row-level validation, native date parsing, and role-based access.

nodes.name: BuildWorkbook
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds an in-memory Excel workbook with a header row and given data rows, used to construct import test fixtures.

nodes.name: Import_AllRowsValid_CommitsAllRows
nodes.summary: Verifies that importing a workbook where every row is valid commits all rows as employees.

nodes.name: Import_JoinDateAsNativeExcelDateCell_ParsesCorrectly
nodes.summary: Verifies that a join date supplied as a native Excel date cell (rather than a text string) is parsed correctly during import.

nodes.name: Import_MixedValidAndInvalidRows_CommitsNothingAndReportsEveryFailingRow
nodes.summary: Verifies that importing a workbook with a mix of valid and invalid rows commits nothing (all-or-nothing) and reports every failing row.

nodes.name: Export_Excel_ReturnsFilteredEmployeesWithStatusAsText
nodes.summary: Verifies that the Excel export endpoint returns only the filtered employees with their active/inactive status rendered as text.

nodes.name: Export_Csv_ReturnsFilteredEmployeesWithStatusAsText
nodes.summary: Verifies that the CSV export endpoint returns only the filtered employees with their active/inactive status rendered as text.

nodes.name: Export_RoundTrip_ExportedFileReimportsCleanly
nodes.summary: Verifies that a file produced by the export endpoint can be fed straight back into the import endpoint without errors, confirming the two formats are compatible.

nodes.name: Viewer_Gets403_OnImportAndExport
nodes.summary: Verifies that a viewer-role user receives 403 Forbidden on both the import and export endpoints.

nodes.name: EmployeeSearchTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering employee search/filtering by name, department and status combined, salary range, and join-date range.

nodes.name: EmployeeSearchTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering the employee list endpoint's filtering and range-query behavior.

nodes.name: Department_AndStatus_Combine_ReturnsOnlyMatchingEmployees
nodes.summary: Verifies that combining department and active-status filters returns only employees matching both criteria.

nodes.name: SalaryRange_ReturnsOnlyEmployeesWithinRange
nodes.summary: Verifies that filtering employees by a min/max salary range returns only employees within that range.

nodes.name: JoinDateRange_ReturnsOnlyEmployeesWithinRange
nodes.summary: Verifies that filtering employees by a join-date range returns only employees who joined within that range.

nodes.name: EmployeesEndpointTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering the employee list endpoint's default paging, custom page size, and clamping of out-of-range paging parameters.

nodes.name: EmployeesEndpointTests
nodes.summary: Test suite covering pagination behavior of the employee list endpoint.

nodes.name: GetEmployees_ReturnsSeededPagedResult
nodes.summary: Verifies that the employee list endpoint returns a paged result containing the seeded employees by default.

nodes.name: GetEmployees_RespectsPageSize
nodes.summary: Verifies that a custom page-size query parameter is respected by the employee list endpoint.

nodes.name: GetEmployees_ClampsOutOfRangePaging
nodes.summary: Verifies that out-of-range page/page-size query parameters are clamped to valid values rather than causing an error.

nodes.name: ExcelManagement.Api.IntegrationTests.csproj
nodes.summary: .NET test project file for the API integration test suite, declaring the xUnit/test-SDK package references and a project reference to the API host being tested.

nodes.name: McpToolsTests.cs
nodes.summary: Integration tests exercising the MCP server tools (department listing, employee list/get/create/update/delete/export) directly against repositories backed by the test host's database scope.

nodes.name: McpToolsTests
nodes.summary: Test suite verifying that the MCP tool methods correctly dispatch to the employee and department repositories and handle not-found/validation cases.

nodes.name: ListDepartments_DispatchesToRepository_ReturnsSeededActiveDepartments
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP ListDepartments tool dispatches to the department repository and returns the seeded active departments.

nodes.name: ListEmployees_DispatchesToRepository_ReturnsPagedShape
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP ListEmployees tool dispatches to the employee repository and returns the expected paged shape.

nodes.name: GetEmployee_DispatchesToRepository_ReturnsDetailForSeededRow
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP GetEmployee tool dispatches to the repository and returns the correct detail for a seeded employee.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_ValidRequest_PersistsThroughRepository
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP CreateEmployee tool persists a valid new employee through the repository.

nodes.name: CreateEmployee_UnknownDepartment_ReturnsValidationErrorsAndDoesNotCreate
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP CreateEmployee tool returns validation errors and does not create a record when the department id is unknown.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_ValidRequest_ChangesPersistedRow
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP UpdateEmployee tool persists field changes to the underlying row.

nodes.name: UpdateEmployee_UnknownId_ReturnsUpdatedFalse
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP UpdateEmployee tool reports updated=false when given an unknown employee id.

nodes.name: DeleteEmployee_ExistingRow_RemovesItAndReportsTrue
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP DeleteEmployee tool removes an existing employee row and reports success.

nodes.name: ExportEmployees_ReturnsEveryRowAcrossPages
nodes.summary: Verifies that the MCP ExportEmployees tool paginates through the repository to return every employee row across pages.
